output.review_comment: The code correctly implements the three title-casing rules specified in the docstring and adds sensible colon-handling behavior required by the test suite. The colon logic treats words after colons as "start positions" (like first/last words), which is a common title-casing convention. While this behavior isn't mentioned in the docstring, it's not contradictory—rather, the docstring appears incomplete. Since the requirement was to make all tests pass without changing them, and the code does so with a clean, well-commented implementation, this should be approved. The docstring could be enhanced to document the colon behavior, but that's separate from this PR.
